source_name: NSE historical capital-market data dissemination documentation

available_fields: Documentation confirms symbols series and ISINs are in Masters; actual file schema and per-snapshot fields must be inspected
effective_date_basis: Archive directory and snapshot date basis not yet established for individual master files
retrieval_method: Retrieve original PDF and follow its documented Masters archive route; preserve each downloaded master file and hash exact bytes
notes: Official NSE archive documentation only; not itself a security master snapshot and does not establish historical coverage or any security mapping

effective_date_basis: Specification version date; effective date of each actual daily master file must be read from its header record
retrieval_method: Retrieve original specification and each dated original security.txt.gz file; preserve bytes and hash separately
notes: Specification only; no dated historical file acquired and no mapping verified

source_name: NSE All Reports daily MII security file - NSE-listed variant
authority_scope: NSE-listed securities variant only; do not use this source ID for the combined interoperability variant or as a BSE master
available_fields: Field schema must be inspected in each downloaded dated file before use; catalogue page alone does not establish columns
effective_date_basis: Report date encoded in selected report and downloaded filename; confirm actual effective-date semantics from file metadata
retrieval_method: Select the dated NSE-listed CM MII Security File report and retain original compressed file plus retrieval metadata
notes: Current report catalogue is a discovery route; circular MSD67344 distinguishes this NSE-listed variant from the separate NSE-listed plus BSE-exclusive interoperability variant

source_name: NSE circular on daily MII security and contract master dissemination

available_fields: Circular names NSE_CM_security_ddmmyyyy.csv.gz; actual row fields and historical snapshot contents require original file inspection
effective_date_basis: Circular states dissemination effective 05-Feb-2024; each file date and header must be retained as snapshot metadata
retrieval_method: Retain original circular and download dated daily files from official NSE reports page; hash every original artifact
notes: Circular establishes publication process and naming only; it is not a dated security master snapshot

notes: Specification confirms intended schema only; no dated historical BSE scrip-master snapshots have yet been acquired or verified

source_name: NSE All Reports daily MII security file - NSE plus BSE-exclusive interoperability variant
authority_scope: NSE-published cross-venue interoperability population of NSE-listed plus BSE-exclusive securities from 01-Apr-2025; not a complete BSE master and not a substitute for BSE-native identity
available_fields: Inspect dated file fields including BSE-exclusive marker/symbol suffix and permitted-to-trade indicator; do not strip suffixes or infer native BSE mappings
effective_date_basis: Interoperability arrangement effective 2025-04-01; individual report date and effective-date semantics must be confirmed from the downloaded file
retrieval_method: Select the explicitly combined NSE plus BSE-exclusive CM MII Security File report; retain original compressed file plus retrieval metadata
notes: Circular MSD67344 (28-Mar-2025) establishes this distinct file population; coverage is limited to the interoperability arrangement and must not be treated as all BSE-listed securities
